concept.name: Quiet Accumulation (Flow-Price Divergence)
concept.definition: QA_t(i) = z_flow_t(i) - beta_t * z_priceresp_t(i); beta_t = expanding no-intercept OLS LAGGED (INV13 accumulator, burn-in 60m). flow leg = frollsum(Foreign(+Inst), LB)/Size (smart-money net-buy, NON-return). price-response leg = frollsum(Ret, LB) SUBTRACTED. Signal = flow NOT explained by contemporaneous price move = 'quiet accumulation'. QA high = LONG.
concept.grid: LB in {21,42,63}d x flow in {F+Inst, Foreign-only}, top_n=20, burn-in 60m. Anchor = FI42 (LB42/F+Inst).
concept.economic_rationale: Llorente-Michaely-Saar-Wang (2002) informed-trading lineage: smart-money net buying NOT accompanied by a contemporaneous price move signals inelastic informed demand not yet impounded. Residualizing the price-response leg isolates the 'unexplained' flow component, structurally orthogonalizing against price momentum (M01). Tests whether KR foreign/institutional flow carries forward edge ONCE the price confound is removed.
concept.redundancy_cluster_id: investor_flow_residual (INV13 accumulator family; microstructure flow-price-divergence M39 neighborhood)
concept.novelty_self_report: concept published (Llorente et al.); KR long-only top-20 construction is the fresh part. novelty=3. Overlaps M39/FPD and INV13.

measurement.metric_type_note: top-N EW long-only contract-grade (build_benchmark_compare, NW lag-3). admission-binding is forge; this is screening/orthogonality real-measurement.
measurement.n_months_note: 195 after 60m burn-in trim (256 sig_dates - burn-in). raw-flow baselines run full 255m.

does_price_residualization_help.question: Does subtracting the price-response leg help vs RAW flow level? (CONTROLLED same-WT same-window same-flow baseline, per Codex C3)
does_price_residualization_help.method: eval_qa_revise.R: recomputed RAW-FLOW (flowsum/Size z-score, NO price removal) for ALL 6 cells using identical snapshots/window/period; delta = QA PORT_t - RAW PORT_t.
does_price_residualization_help.verdict_corrected: NO, and NOT systematically — price-residualization is MIXED, never material. Controlled: QA improves vs raw in 2/6 cells (both 21d short-window, +0.24/+0.46) and HURTS in 4/6 (-0.29 to -1.14, worse at longer windows). In NO cell does residualization move the signal toward positive/graduating territory. Both raw flow AND price-removed QA are null-to-negative. The price-removal hypothesis is FALSIFIED as a rescue: flow carries NO hidden forward edge masked by price in KR top-20 long-only. [DRAFT CORRECTION per Codex C3: draft claimed blanket 'HURTS' on an uncontrolled external baseline; controlled truth is 'mixed, never enough to matter'.]

diagnostics_post_codex.subperiod_note: All three subperiods negative ICIR, stability 1.0 — robustly mildly ANTI-predictive, NOT noise (draft 'within noise' RETRACTED per Codex).
diagnostics_post_codex.decile_note: Strongly INVERSE: low-QA decile earns 1.74%/mo, high-QA 0.65%/mo. High 'quiet accumulation' names systematically UNDERperform — the cleanest characterization of the negative.

M01_12_1.note: Anti-corr NOT observed at active level (+0.52). Despite SUBTRACTING price leg, the long top-20 QA portfolio co-moves with momentum portfolio — both share the KR market-beta-~0.99 floor (memory S6). score-level rho low (0.09) but active-return rho high: the orthogonalization works cross-sectionally but evaporates in the realized long-only active series (market component dominates).

INV13_accumulator.note: QA is NOT just INV13 relabeled at score level (rho 0.18); but active-return rho 0.54 (~ at threshold) — same market floor.

Size.note: No small-cap accumulation bias — Size orthogonality clean.

orthogonality_active_basis.interpretation: Score-level orthogonalization succeeds (low score_rho vs M01/INV13), confirming the construction does what it claims cross-sectionally. But active-return correlations are all 0.51-0.68 because KR long-only top-20 portfolios share the ~0.99 market beta floor — the residualization removes a cross-sectional confound but cannot remove the shared market component in a long-only realized series. This is the spec honest_risk #1 made manifest: 'orthogonal != profitable' and 'price-removal strips market component.'

vs_INV13_base_accumulator.question: Does QA do better than INV13 (which itself did not graduate, 16/16 PORT_t FAIL cohort)?
vs_INV13_base_accumulator.answer: NO. QA does not improve on INV13. QA anchor PORT_t -1.43 vs the INV13-cohort failures (all < 0). Price-residualization neither rescues the flow signal nor produces a distinct profitable residual. QA score_rho vs INV13 = 0.18 (distinct construction, NOT relabeled), but both share the same null/negative forward edge. Confirms 'orthogonal != profitable' at one more data point.

verdict.summary: Quiet Accumulation (flow minus price-response) has NO standalone forward edge in KR top-20 long-only; robustly mildly ANTI-predictive (anchor PORT_t -1.43, rank_ic -0.012, subperiod ICIR all negative, decile monotonicity -0.903). CONTROLLED comparison: price-residualization is MIXED vs raw flow (helps 2/6 short-window cells, hurts 4/6), never moving toward graduating territory — both raw flow AND QA are null-to-negative. Confirms C21's 'flow level has no edge' AND extends it: removing the price confound does not unmask hidden flow alpha. Score-level orthogonalization succeeds but active-return orthogonality fails (shared KR market-beta floor). 'orthogonal != profitable' at one more data point.
verdict.campaign_note: This is ONE data point in an ongoing exhaustive momentum-hunt campaign. NOT a structural limit (AX-000 amended forbids declaring limits). The 'flow-level' axis (raw + price-residualized) is now well-characterized as null in KR top-20 long-only; the campaign continues to other non-return-derived concepts.
verdict.honest_reporting: A clean negative reported faithfully IS success (AX-000 amended 2026-06-21).
